test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Three years ago, the value of car was Rs. 2,50,000. If the value depreciates by 6% every year, its value now is:
solution:
**Given:**

Initial value of the car = Rs. 2,50,000.

Depreciation rate = 6% per annum.

Time = 3 years.

**Formula Used:**

Value after n years = Initial value × (1 - depreciation rate)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Depreciation rate = 6% = 0.06

Value after 3 years = 2,50,000 × (1 - 0.06)³

⇒ Value after 3 years = 2,50,000 × (0.94)³

⇒ Value after 3 years = 2,50,000 × 0.830584

⇒ Value after 3 years = Rs. 2,07,646

**The value of the car now is Rs. 2,07,646.**
